patterns: Other PSCs ask textbook one-liners: moderator = heavy water/graphite, atom bomb = fission, Sun = fusion, Nagasaki = plutonium, control rods prevent runaway, breeder makes more fuel than it burns.

APPSC items are India-programme specific: thorium bombarded gives U-233, PFBR built by BHAVINI (2024), Dhruva largest research reactor + AHWR not plutonium-based (A-R 2025), ITER statements (2022), 'breaking of nucleus is fusion' false (2019).
Recurring traps: IGCAR designs vs BHAVINI builds; AHWR uses thorium not plutonium spent fuel; fusion vs fission wording swaps; heavy water as moderator vs coolant.
App MCQs are mostly sound but lean on 2025-26 data (SHANTI Act, fleet MW, ANEEL, Kazakhstan share) and multi-statement formats more than the direct items PYQs use.
Many filed PYQs are general atomic physics/chemistry that belong to other science topics.
